response.overview: In a quiet suburban home, young Frankie’s evening is shattered when his parents burst through the door in a heated argument. Between his father’s out-of-control gambling addiction and his dissatisfied mother, their marriage is at its breaking point. In a futile bid for attention, Frankie attempts to destroy the contents of the house and snap them out of their verbal warfare. Struggling with the consequences of his family’s descent and his own emotional turmoil, Shattered explores a world where love comes at a cost.
response.title: Shattered
